messages:
maria: Quick announcement: rolling a minor release Sat 06:00 PT to adjust batching defaults and fix a warmup timeout. No model changes.

release-bot: Release scheduled: train_id=rt-1805000001, start=1805000001, steps=[10,40,100], step_duration=15m, notify=#eng-releases

eng-sre: Ops note: we'll run EU-first canary for 10m then global. Set p95 alert to 250ms and error-rate to 0.5% for auto-rollback.

noah: Dev note: default batch size lowered 28->20 for low-latency routes. Also fixed warmup handshake that could stall cold-starts. No API changes.

leena: QA will run smoke + long-chat continuity on step 1. Expected quick-pass in 25m after step 1. If token gaps detected, mark as fail and hold rollout.

ops-bot: Autoscale cushion increased by 15% for 2 hours post-rollout.

maria: Freeze policy: 1h soft-freeze after full rollout. Non-critical deploys blocked during freeze. Exceptions need release lead + eng dir approval.

qa: We'll post results in thread. Assigning owners: maria (release lead), noah (dev), eng-sre (ops), qa (tests). Will post readiness 20m before start :white_check_mark:
